name: ASIMO
summary: ASIMO is a walking humanoid robot developed by Honda. Honda debuted it on 20 November 2000 as "a new small, lightweight humanoid robot named ASIMO that employs Honda's new robotic walking technology", and Honda's robotics pages describe it as "a humanoid robot developed with the aim of helping people". Specifications and current commercial status have not yet been verified.

spec_caveats.text: Honda states 'Operating degrees of freedom: Total 34 degrees of freedom' (https://global.honda/en/newsroom/news/2005/c051213-asimo-eng.html). DEC-05: Honda's 2005 New ASIMO release (130 cm, 54 kg, matching this record); the 2011 model has 57 DoF. This record is the 2005 New ASIMO (owner ruling).

Honda states 'Normal walking speed: 2.7km/hour' (https://global.honda/en/newsroom/news/2005/c051213-asimo-eng.html). DEC-05: 2.7 km/h = 0.75 m/s (unit conversion), Honda's 2005 New ASIMO release; running speed 6 km/h is not walking speed. This record is the 2005 New ASIMO (owner ruling).

Honda states ASIMO can 'recognize the surrounding environment through its visual sensors' (https://global.honda/en/newsroom/news/2005/c051213-asimo-eng.html). DEC-05: 2005 New ASIMO (owner ruling 2026-10-23).

Honda states 'A new function to carry objects using a cart was also added' and shows 'ASIMO passing tray' (https://global.honda/en/newsroom/news/2005/c051213-asimo-eng.html). DEC-05: 2005 New ASIMO (owner ruling 2026-10-23).
